name: Lonewolf Set
desc: Magazine +10%, Crit Rate +5%. Crit → Lone Shadow stacks (až +60% Crit DMG). Univerzální endgame set.

name: Shelterer Set
desc: Status DMG Reduction + Element DMG. Základ pro elemental (Blaze/Frost/Shock/Blast) buildy.

name: Falcon Set
desc: Mid-game combat set. Crit a weapon DMG bonusy. Snadno z world crates.

name: Scout Set
desc: Max HP + Weapon DMG, bonus při undetected. Early combat.

name: Raid Set
desc: Gathering Speed + Load, méně Staminy při glide/roll. Farm set.

name: Rustic Set
desc: Movement Speed, Melee DMG, HP, Gathering. Starter set.

name: Bastille Set
desc: Obranný set se shield mechanikou a vulnerability při break.

name: Blackstone Set
desc: Way of Winter legendary set. Vysoké HP / Pollution / Psi.

name: Agent Set
desc: Fragments from Mystical Crates – Iron River.

name: Treacherous Tides Set
desc: Reworked in 3.0.6: DMG bonus no longer scales with Sanity. Scales with HP instead. 2pc: when HP <70%, Weapon+Status DMG +12%. 3pc: base Weapon/Status DMG at 100% HP +8%, increases as HP drops (max 28%). 4pc: shield enhancement retained.

name: Ghost Link Set
desc: Added with 3.0.1 anniversary weapons. 1pc: Crit rate up. 2pc: Reload efficiency up. 3pc conditions adjusted in 3.0.4 balance pass. Synergizes with Unstable Bomber / QBJ97 line.

name: Wind Interpreter Cap
desc: 3.0.1 piece: When Unstable Bomber explodes, auto-load 1 bullet; Unstable Bomber DMG Rate +25%.

name: Ankh Mask
desc: 3.0.1 piece: Emptying magazine has a chance to consume ammo stock and partially refill magazine.

name: Glide Pants
desc: May 2026 gear: Roll becomes slide; after slide Reload Speed + Movement Speed. With bow: slide loads 1 ammo, increases draw speed.

name: Magnetic Moment Top
desc: May 2026 gear: Units with Power Surge continuously pull nearby enemies. Pairs with AUG - Electron Cloud.
